body.statement: For every \((i,i')\) with \(\Sigma_{ii'}\ne0\), the scope \(N_G[i]\cup N_G[i']\) is a clique of \(F\), occurs in at least one bag of \(\mathcal T\), and has a unique highest containing bag. Consequently its contribution to \(V\) is determined by that bag labeling and is charged exactly once by \(H_t\).
body.justification: The lemma converts a non-pairwise covariance objective into local bag potentials without approximation.
body.gap: Generic connectivity dynamic programs charge vertex or edge weights; Zhu et al.'s factor depends on all labels across a covariance-supported union of exposure neighborhoods.
body.consumer: It supplies the objective-locality step required by the exact treewidth algorithm.
